selected_evidence.requirement: Topology mapping: identify which node1 NIC serves node2 vs node3
selected_evidence.summary: node1 eth1/eth2 identified as data links; temp IP+ping test proved eth1<->node2 and eth2<->node3

selected_evidence.requirement: eth1 (node2 link) configured as untagged access port in its own VLAN (100)
selected_evidence.summary: bridge vlan add/del set eth1 PVID 100 untagged, removed from default VLAN 1

selected_evidence.requirement: eth2 (node3 link) configured as untagged access port in its own VLAN (200)
selected_evidence.summary: bridge vlan add/del set eth2 PVID 200 untagged, removed from default VLAN 1

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 retains a working link to node2 inside VLAN 100 and to node3 inside VLAN 200
selected_evidence.summary: node1 pings 192.168.50.2 (node2, VLAN100 SVI) and 192.168.51.2 (node3, VLAN200 SVI) successfully, including post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: The two hosts (node2, node3) stay separated from one another
selected_evidence.summary: node2 given explicit route to node3's subnet via node1; ping still 100% loss both before and after all node restarts, proving per-VLAN forwarding is disabled and segments are isolated

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id ce04f497... and confirmed both VLAN links working pre-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnect, connection reset/timeout observed during reboot, boot_id changed to e701a966... after recovery

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery of VLAN config and connectivity
selected_evidence.summary: vlan-segmentation.service active, br0/br0.100/br0.200 and VLAN membership recreated automatically, forwarding still 0, both host pings succeed

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline ping ok, reboot acknowledged, boot_id changed from d7a80301... to 1e64afa0..., post-restart ping to node1 and device state recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline ping ok, reboot acknowledged, boot_id changed from 73bafeef... to c5094b66..., post-restart ping to node1 and device state recovered
